title: 第1802章 就是这么报答我的第1801章 你不是在开玩笑
lines: 楚流年有些发懵，手上的动作也不由得放缓了。
她察觉出叶风这小子似乎并不是在开玩笑。
神寂境？
十七岁的神寂境？
关键是叶风在去年这个时候，连御空飞行都没有达到呢。
短短一年时间，这小子的修为怎么可能连跳好几级？就算是民间的传奇小说，都不敢这么写吧。
“唉唉唉，流年，你手上的动作怎么停了？”
见楚流年发懵，叶风忍不住出言提醒。
不过这小子脸上却充满着得意。
他要的就是这个效果。
别说是神寂境，十七岁达到归元巅峰境，便已经足以震惊天下。
楚流年身子微微一抖，她道：“你……你真是怪胎！”
“不不不，我这不叫怪胎，是万年一遇的修真奇才！”
楚流年的易容水平还不到家，易容的速度不像秦璎姑娘或者凌云志那么快。
二人有一句没一句的聊着。
叶风询问了楚流年这段时间在圣女宗待的习不习惯。
楚流年就算不习惯，也不会说出口的。
现在她这种情况，能有一个落脚地已经很不错了，她如今已经不奢求返回玉女宗了。
一番交谈后，叶风又道：“流年，如果最近几天能解决天剑宗的事儿，那你和义父就和我们一起前往灵山看热闹。”
“我？尊主的眼线遍布人间各处，我还是老老实实的待在这里吧。”
“没事儿，你现在的样貌，就算你亲爹亲娘站在你面前，都不可能认出你的，放心就是了，当然，前提是这两天能解决掉天剑宗这个隐患。
若是解决不了，你和义父只能继续待在这里看守圣女宗。”
“宗主，你真的打算和天剑宗硬碰硬吗？”
叶风缓缓点头，道：“圣女宗在这件事上不能表现出任何的软弱，否则后患无穷。
现在的局面还在可控范围之内，只要将天剑宗给打服了，方圆几百里的其他道家门派，就不敢再觊觎万佛峰了。”
楚流年轻轻点头，道：“话虽如此，但天剑宗的整体实力是圣女宗的几十倍，若真打起来，吃亏的恐怕是我们圣女宗。宗门内的姑娘们虽然绝大多数都已经御空飞行境，但她们连御剑飞行都不熟练呢。修为最好的也就是御神境，根本没有形成战斗力。”
叶风道：“我知道，所以我不会让圣女宗的弟子和天剑宗的弟子硬拼，想要震慑住天剑宗，靠我们这些年轻人是不可能的，只能靠义父这位天止境的绝世强者……”
楚流年走出叶风房间时已经是后半夜了。
叶风拿出镜子对照了一番。
在楚流年的努力下，他的样貌确实改变了不少，但还是有一些叶风的样貌。
叶风对自己易容后的样貌并不是特别满意，比起前段时间在山洞里会见落英宗罗飞云时的那个英俊帅气的小鲜肉的模样差远了。
不过这不要紧，对于自己是圣女宗宗主的事儿，叶风也没打算隐瞒太久。
content_en:
Chu Liunian was a little confused, and the movements of his hands could not help but slow down.
She noticed that Ye Feng didn't seem to be joking.
The realm of divine silence?
The state of divine tranquility at the age of seventeen?
The key is that at this time last year, Ye Feng had not even reached the level of flying in the sky.
How could this kid's cultivation level jump several levels in just one year? Even folk legendary novels would not dare to write like this.
"Alas, fleeting time, why did the movements of your hands stop?"
Seeing Chu Liunian confused, Ye Feng couldn't help but remind him.
But this kid's face was full of pride.
This is the effect he wants.
Not to mention the Divine Silence Realm, reaching the peak Guiyuan Realm at the age of seventeen is enough to shock the world.
Chu Liunian trembled slightly and said, "You...you are such a freak!"
"No, no, no, I'm not a freak, I'm a once-in-a-million-year cultivation wizard!"
Chu Liunian's level of disguise is not as good as that of Miss Qin Ying or Ling Yunzhi.
The two of them chatted wordlessly.
Ye Feng asked Chu Liunian if he was used to staying in the Saintess Sect during this period.
Even if Chu Liunian wasn't used to it, he wouldn't say it out loud.
Now that she is in this situation, it is good to have a place to stay. She no longer desires to return to the Jade Girl Sect.
After a conversation, Ye Feng said again: "Fleeing time, if the Tianjian Sect's affairs can be resolved in the next few days, then you and your adoptive father will go to Lingshan with us to watch the excitement."
"Me? The Lord's spies are everywhere in the world, so I'd better stay here honestly."
"It's okay. With your current appearance, even if your biological father and mother stand in front of you, they won't be able to recognize you. Just don't worry. Of course, the premise is that the hidden danger of Tianjian Sect can be solved in the past two days.
If it can't be solved, you and your adoptive father can only continue to stay here to guard the Saintess Sect. "
"Sect Master, do you really plan to confront the Tianjian Sect head-on?"
Ye Feng nodded slowly and said: "The Holy Lady Sect cannot show any weakness in this matter, otherwise there will be endless troubles.
The current situation is still within control. As long as the Tianjian Sect is defeated, other Taoist sects within a few hundred miles will no longer dare to covet Ten Thousand Buddhas Peak. "
Chu Liuyoun nodded lightly and said: "Having said that, the overall strength of the Tianjian Sect is dozens of times that of the Saintess Sect. If there is a fight, we, the Saintess Sect, will probably suffer. Although most of the girls in the sect have reached the air-controlling flying realm, they are not even proficient in sword-controlling flying. The ones with the best cultivation are at the god-controlling realm and have no combat effectiveness at all."
Ye Feng said: "I know, so I will not let the disciples of the Holy Lady Sect and the disciples of the Tianjian Sect fight head-on. If we want to scare the Tianjian Sect, it is impossible to rely on young people like us. We can only rely on my foster father, a peerless powerhouse in the Tianzhi Realm..."
It was already late at night when Chu Liunian walked out of Ye Feng's room.
Ye Feng took out a mirror and checked it.
With Chu Liunian's efforts, his appearance has indeed changed a lot, but he still has some of Ye Feng's appearance.
Ye Feng was not particularly satisfied with his appearance after his disguise. It was far worse than the handsome young man he looked when he met Luo Feiyun of Luo Yingzong in the cave some time ago.
But it doesn't matter. Ye Feng doesn't intend to hide the fact that he is the leader of the Saintess Sect for too long.
title_en: Chapter 1802 This is how you repay me Chapter 1801 You are not kidding
